payload.title: Use outcome-focused experiment operations
payload.decision: Across all experiments and Kaggle notebooks, require only the checks needed to obtain a correct, readable result: required inputs, visible failures, expected rows and IDs, finite predictions, saved outputs, and experiment-specific scientific controls. Internet state, CPU or accelerator checks, thread-pool checks, repeated hashes, exact byte parity, environment inventories, and verbose manifests are not default gates.
payload.rationale: The prior workflow overcommitted effort to operational ceremony that did not improve model quality or the ability to produce a valid output. The new policy keeps scientific validation strict while making execution and output retrieval simple.
payload.revisit_trigger: Add a specific operational check only after a demonstrated failure shows that the check prevents an incorrect or unusable result.
